opening.argument: The video walks viewers through deploying an AI-agent identity and related contracts on Avalanche testnet. Its instructions to clone code, install dependencies, configure a wallet private key and deploy are presented as steps in that developer walkthrough. The faucet interaction likewise appears in the testnet setup, where the demonstration uses test tokens described as having no real-world monetary value. The private-key step is sensitive, but the speaker expressly tells viewers to use a test wallet containing zero real money and never share its key. On the available evidence, this is an operational demonstration, not a request for real funds or a presentation of a financial product or investment opportunity.

citations.quote: show you step-by-step how to deploy a live AI Agent Identity on the Avalanche blockchain using the new ERC-8004 standard.
